written.text: Define the following terms:(4×1=4)
In an Under Ground Coal Mine, 1800 workers are employed. The average production from the mine is 900 tonne per day. Assuming 3 working shifts per day, calculate the Output per Man Shift (OMS). (5)
Broken rock of 3684 m³ is heaped into a square pyramid of height 12 m. Calculate the base area in metre square.(5)
Four benches are being worked by the opencast mining system. Height, width and face angle for each bench are 15m, 50m and 70º respectively. Calculate the overall slope angle of the benches. (5)
The ratio of uniaxial compressive strength to uniaxial tensile strength of a sandstone specimen is 8:1. Calculate the theoretical value of angle of internal friction of the specimen in degree.(5)

A series of triaxial tests of sandstone samples reveal the cohesion and the angle of internal friction as 21.65 MPa and 30º respectively. Based on the assumption that the sandstone samples and by following the Mohr-Coulomb’s failure criteria, calculate the tensile strength in Mpa.(6) 2-82-8

In a mine ventilation system, the resistances of two splits A and B are 0.5 Nsm and 2 Nsm respectively. Combined resistance of two shafts and trunk airways is 0.7 Ns²m⁻⁸. A quantity of 20 m³/s of air passes through split A. Calculate the total air quantity passing the mine in m³/s.(5)

State the three fundamental Fan Laws used in mine ventilation. If the rotational speed of a mine fan is doubled, what will be the resulting effect on the quantity of airflow, ventilating pressure, and fan power?(5)
Define dip and strike. Illustrate with suitable diagram.(5)
Define Fold? Distinguish between Anticline and Syncline by illustrating with the help of suitable diagrams.(5)
Define Ultimate Analysis and Proximate Analysis of coal. List the constituents determined in each method.(5)

In an underground coal mine using the bord and pillar method, a development panel provides the following production data for a single shift:(5) Number of blasting rounds fired per shift: 8 Dimensions of the face exposed for each blast: 4.2 m (width) × 2.5 m (height) Average pull obtained per blast: 1.2 m Specific gravity of coal: 1.4 Total manpower employed in the panel per shift: 100

subparts.a: Determine the Output per Manshift (OMS) for the panel in tonnes.
subparts.b: Comment briefly on whether the OMS value indicates high, moderate, or low productivity for a development district in an underground coal mine.

written.text: A rectangular coal pillar is formed with center-to-center dimensions of 30 m × 30 m in an underground mine. The width of each gallery is 5.0 m, and the depth of the working is 200 m. If the unit weight of the overlying strata is 0.025 MPa/m, calculate the load (stress) acting on the pillar using the Tributary Area Method.(5)
What is Rock Quality Designation (RQD)? Explain how it is determined and give the standard classification of rock mass based on RQD values.(5)

The uni-axial compressive strength (_cᵢ) of intact shale is 50 MPa. 1=3+ci (mβ   3/ci +s)^a Find the uniaxial compressive strength of rock mass.(5) σ

Sample of air collected in the intake and return gate roads of an advancing longwall face show 0.25% and 0.75% CH₄, respectively. The panel has a production of 400 tonnes in an 8-hour shift, when an air quality of 18 m³/s passes through it, what will be the emission in m³/t of coal produced.(5)
